current.bodyMarkdown:
## 📌 Claude-Voyager 1.3.0 — 修复 timeline，优化 folder

### 🕐 时间线：长对话终于有全部的点了

Claude 的对话流是**虚拟列表**——83 轮的对话，DOM 里同时只存在 8 行，滚出视野的轮次连占位元素都没有。旧版时间线是数 DOM 画点的，所以一条 83 轮的长对话**只画得出 4 个点**。这不是「要多点几下才能定位」，是远处的轮次压根就没有点可以点。

1.3.0 改成从对话数据取全量轮次：

- **点位补全**：实测 83/83、32/32、14/14，一个不少
- **一次到位**：跳转先过冲再逐帧收敛。虚拟列表在滚动过程中会把估算高度换成实测高度（实测一次跳转页面总高从 41595px 涨到 49464px），单次定位必然落短——所以改成盯着目标行收敛，落位准确
- **图钉和收藏不会丢**：消息 id 从「第几个」换成了稳定 id，迁移是**惰性增量**的：读的时候新旧都认，写的时候**先写新的再删旧的**，任何一步失败都保持原样

### 📂 文件夹：整段可收、拖动腾位、跟着侧栏滚

- **一键收成一条线**：标题栏的眼睛按钮把整个文件夹区收成一条 6px 的细线（346px → 22px），点这条线再展开。不想看的时候侧栏就跟没装扩展一样干净
- **拖动时其他行让位**：拖起一个文件夹或对话，所有可插入的位置会撑开 8px，松手复原——不用再对着 0 像素的缝隙瞄准
- **行高对齐 Claude 原生**：文件夹行和对话行统一 36px，行距归零，和侧栏自带的会话列表一个节奏
- **🆕 文件夹放到项目下方（默认开启）**：以前文件夹面板是**钉死在侧栏顶部**的，永远占着最上面一块。现在默认挪进滚动区，位置在「项目」下方、「最近」上方，**跟着侧栏一起滚**。想要回到置顶的，在扩展弹窗里关掉这个开关即可

### 🔧 还有

- 文件夹图标不再是 `+` `⋯` `>` 这种 ASCII 顶替——Claude 没有 Google Symbols 字体，现在换成了真正的矢量图标
- 展开/收起文件夹不再整列表重建，动画不会再被闪掉
- 配色从紫色系统一换成 Claude 橘

## 🔒 关于数据

这一轮动了不少存储相关的代码路径，但**没有重命名任何既有的存储键**。文件夹、收藏、图钉、提示词全部原地保留，更新不会丢。相关的回归测试已经钉在仓库里，清理动作让它变红就是清理错了。

## 💬 反馈

有需求或发现 bug，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/Claude-voyager/issues) 提交。

---

## 📌 Claude-Voyager 1.3.0 — Timeline fixed, folders improved

### 🕐 Timeline: long conversations finally get every dot

Claude renders the transcript as a **virtual list** — in an 83-turn conversation only 8 rows exist in the DOM at once, and off-screen turns have no placeholder element at all. The old timeline counted DOM rows, so an 83-turn thread drew **4 dots**. That wasn't "you have to click a few times to get there" — the far turns simply had no dot to click.

1.3.0 reads every turn from the conversation data instead:

- **Complete dots**: measured 83/83, 32/32, 14/14
- **Lands first try**: a jump overshoots, then converges frame by frame. The virtual list swaps estimated row heights for measured ones as you scroll (one measured jump grew the page from 41595px to 49464px), so a single scroll always falls short — converging on the target row fixes that
- **Pins and stars survive**: message ids moved from positional to stable, migrated **lazily and additively** — both forms are accepted on read, the new entry is written **before** the old one is removed, and any failure leaves the original untouched

### 📂 Folders: collapsible, they make room while dragging, and they scroll

- **Collapse the whole section to a line**: the eye button in the header shrinks the folder area to a 6px strip (346px → 22px); click the strip to bring it back
- **Rows make room while you drag**: every insertion point opens to 8px during a drag and closes again on drop — no more aiming at a zero-pixel seam
- **Row rhythm matches Claude**: folder and conversation rows are both 36px with no inter-row gap, same as the native chat list
- **🆕 Place folders below Projects (on by default)**: the folder panel used to be **pinned to the top of the sidebar**, permanently occupying that space. It now sits in the scroll flow between Projects and Recents and **scrolls with the rest of the sidebar**. Prefer it pinned? Turn the switch off in the extension popup

### 🔧 Also

- Folder icons are real vectors now. Claude ships no Google Symbols font, so they had been falling back to ASCII `+`, `...` and `>`
- Expanding a folder no longer rebuilds the whole list, so the animation isn't flashed away
- Palette moved off violet onto Claude orange

## 🔒 About your data

This round touched a number of storage code paths, but **no existing storage key was renamed**. Folders, stars, pins and prompts all stay exactly where they were; updating will not drop them. The regression tests that guard this live in the repo — if a cleanup turns them red, the cleanup is wrong.

## 💬 Feedback

Requests and bugs are welcome at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/Claude-voyager/issues).
